originality.rationale: Full-text inspected source results and actual semantic record searches did not imply the new seven-map friendship-graph switching semigroup, necessary-and-sufficient uniform three-letter reset criterion, or coupled exact census and random reset law. The 2021 Fran--Saputri--Kiftiah friendship-graph matrix-product theorem establishes graphicality of the adjacency square, but does not state the seven-map switching classification or orbit counts. The closest fixed-rule parity census is on complete multipartite graphs, which omit F_m for m>=2. Specialized unindexed literature remains a priority risk.
residual_risks: Prior specialized parity automata on windmill/friendship graphs may use different terminology or lack full-text indexing.

value.rationale: Complete semigroup enumeration for a natural infinite family of graphs yields a sharp necessary-and-sufficient exact reset-word criterion, full fixed-rule orbit populations, and a nontrivial exact random-uniform-reset law. It goes beyond isolated examples or a numeric invariant and clarifies a structurally useful distinction between real-valued graph sensitivity and finite-field finite-time behavior.
